title: Holding Views in Structs
goal: Connect the lifetime parameter of a struct to its reference field and method output.
hints: Every struct holding a reference must declare a generic lifetime parameter.
The struct parameter 'a must match the field's reference lifetime.
explanation: Structs holding references must declare generic lifetime parameters like `struct Parser<'a>` and apply them to fields like `source: &'a str`. Leaving the generic off causes `E0106` (missing lifetime specifier) or `E0107` (wrong number of lifetime arguments in impl). Declaring `<'b>` while using `&'a str` produces undeclared lifetime `E0261`. Using `String` as the field type causes type mismatch `E0308` when returning `&'a str` in `peek`.
